review:
A feel-good pastry shop on 20 lines. You need at least seven mixer scatters for free spins – seven, eight or nine give four, five or six spins.

The bonus has a secret ingredient: the Swap feature, where reels 1 and 5, then 2 and 4, switch places and create new combinations. Medium-low volatility, 4,000x max and a 97.37% RTP – among the best we list. Free spins about once every 117 spins. Easy for beginners.
pros: Excellent 97.37% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 117 spins on average)
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
